name: 93210 · Coalinga, CA
findings: ZIP 93210 (Coalinga) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93210 (Coalinga) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
80% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
